Messages.Author: Charles Richard Robb
Messages.Body:
Cyberai (cyb...@aol.com) wrote:
: If, during combat, my opponent goes into torpor before I've used all

: my strikes,
: can I still attack doing additional damage or are the additional attacks
: wasted.
: And if I can still attack, can I just go ahead and diablorize my opponent?

You resolve the initial strike first and if he goes to torpor [say from aggr. damage], combat is over and additional strikes are wasted.

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
cyb...@aol.com (Cyberai) writes:

> If, during combat, my opponent goes into torpor before I've used all
my strikes,
>can I still attack doing additional damage or are the additional attacks
>wasted.

Once he's in torpor, combat is over. No more strikes.

>And if I can still attack, can I just go ahead and diablorize my
opponent?

No. There is a card (Amaranth) to allow diablerie of a vampire torporized
in combat.

Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
cyb...@aol.com (Cyberai) writes:

> If, during combat, my opponent goes into torpor before I've used all
>my strikes,
>can I still attack doing additional damage or are the additional attacks
>wasted.

Wasted. Combat ends during the damage resolution sub-phase of the strike
phase that sent the oponent to torpor.

>And if I can still attack, can I just go ahead and diablorize my opponent?

Moot.

no.
once a minion in combat goes to torpor combat ends unless undead

> And if I can still attack, can I just go ahead and diablorize my opponent?

so to diasblorize you have to encounter the minion in torpor.
